name: rime-ii
description: RIME-II: RV32IMFC soft CPU with fused integer/FP datapath, interrupts, Zbb, compressed instructions

notes.fused_path: No separate FPU — integer ALU adder/shifter/comparator are time-multiplexed for FP operations
notes.dsp_usage: 2x MULT18X18D shared between FMUL.S, integer MUL, and Newton-Raphson FDIV.S/FSQRT.S
notes.lzc_shared: 24-bit leading zero counter shared between FP normalization and Zbb CLZ instruction
notes.nr_division: FDIV.S via Newton-Raphson: table lookup + 4 iterations (~45 cycles)
notes.nr_sqrt: FSQRT.S via Newton-Raphson: table lookup + 4 iterations (~65 cycles)
